title: Portraits
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 23 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Heads that look like people. After a summer of masks, the faces in this room have brows, lids, cheeks and worried eyes. They wear hats. Some are painted, some are a single line, and a few are skulls lit by colored beams. Twenty-three works from August 20 to October 5, 2022.

The eyes do the work. A mask's eyes are rings and spirals; these eyes have whites, pupils and lids, and most of them look somewhere. An old man looks past you. A woman with pink hair looks down. A face in blue line looks straight out with tears on its cheeks.

Watch what happens on October 3, when three portraits are drawn in a morning with almost no color, in a single wandering line. After them the room closes with two round heads in goggles, each with words beside it.

chapters.title: Painted Faces
chapters.opening: August 20 to September 2. A head in black scribble on red, an old man with worried eyes, and a face on yellow with a red target for one eye.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #234
works.text: A head drawn in heavy black scribble on red, its face a tangle of pink line, a single yellow bar across the eyes like a blindfold.
works.caption: A head in heavy black scribble on red, pink line for a face, a yellow bar across the eyes.
works.reading: The black strokes are thick and fast, and they leave the red showing through at the face. The pink lines inside are small and looped. The yellow bar is one straight stroke with white beside it. Forty-one strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #260
works.text: An old man's face fills the square, painted in grey, green and yellow with scribble over it, his eyes wide and unmatched, his mouth open on a row of teeth. The brow is furrowed and the cheeks are hollow. Blocks of blue, green, yellow and red stand around him like a wall. It is the first face in the collection that looks frightened, and with 267 recorded strokes one of the most worked in the room.
works.caption: An old man's face painted in grey and green, eyes wide and unmatched, mouth open on a row of teeth.
works.reading: The left eye is larger and looks down and to the side; the right is smaller and looks up. Both have grey irises with white around them. The mouth is a dark oval with white teeth in the upper jaw. Colored scribble runs over the whole face in short strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #267
works.text: A head on yellow, painted in grey and green, with a red spiral target for one eye and a red cross for the other, its teeth bared, a striped collar below.
works.caption: A head on yellow, a red spiral target for one eye, a red cross for the other, teeth bared.
works.reading: The target eye is drawn as red rings around a dark center, and the cross sits above the other eye like a bandage. The mouth is a wide grin of white teeth outlined in red. The collar is striped in blue and white. Eighty-six strokes.

chapters.title: Hats and Beams
chapters.opening: September 6 to 8. Figures lit by beams, a wrapped head in goggles, a man in a bucket hat, a profile in line, and a face under a top hat.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #272
works.text: Two dark figures stand against black, each with two glowing yellow eyes, and beams of gold pour from the eyes down to the lower left.
works.caption: Two dark figures against black, each with two glowing yellow eyes, beams of gold pouring down.
works.reading: The figures are painted in grey and purple with pink line over them, and the beams are broad wedges of gold that cross each other. The eyes are soft yellow discs. Recorded with 324 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #275
works.text: A head wrapped in white bandages on yellow, with two round black goggles and a grin of pointed teeth.
works.caption: A head wrapped in white bandages on yellow, two round black goggles and a grin of pointed teeth.
works.reading: The bandages are drawn as white bands with black shadows between them, running around the head and the shoulders. The goggles are two black circles. The teeth are a row of triangles. Ninety-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #276
works.text: A man in a green bucket hat, painted in pink and brown, with two round glasses over two round eyes and a round open mouth. His neck is thin and his shoulders are lost in a town of blocks and lines in red, blue and black. The hat is drawn in green and black with the brim turned down. He is the first person in the collection to wear a hat and glasses.
works.caption: A man in a green bucket hat with round glasses over round eyes and a round open mouth.
works.reading: The glasses are two black rings, and the eyes inside are white with dark centers. The mouth is a red oval with a dark hole. The blocks around the shoulders are drawn in red, blue and black line like buildings. Recorded with 138 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #277
works.text: A profile in line on dark green: a head with yellow hair, a pink face, one eye looking out, and a blue coat, drawn in thirty-seven strokes.
works.caption: A profile drawn in line on dark green, yellow hair, a pink face, one eye, a blue coat.
works.reading: The face is a pink outline with a red mouth and an eye drawn as a blue ring. The hair is yellow zigzag. The coat is a blue outline with a few inner lines. Nothing is filled.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #281
works.text: A red face under a black top hat, with two yellow crowns for eyes, a bar of white teeth and a row of yellow beads across the brow, on dark red.
works.caption: A red face under a black top hat, yellow crowns for eyes, a bar of white teeth, on dark red.
works.reading: The eyes are two yellow zigzag crowns over small marks. The teeth are a long white bar with black lines across it. The beads along the brow are yellow ovals. Green dots run up the left side. Recorded with 145 strokes.

chapters.title: Skulls in Colored Light
chapters.opening: September 14 to 22. A hatted face with fangs, a scribbled face with teeth, three skulls lit by beams, a gridded face and a woman with pink hair.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #282
works.text: A face in a black hat with a spiral eye and a red eye, a mustache, a mouth of fangs, and green dots floating beside it, on a ground of blue stripes.
works.caption: A face in a black hat with a spiral eye and a red eye, a mustache, fangs, green dots beside.
works.reading: The hat is a wide black band with a red brim. The mustache is drawn in yellow line, and the mouth below it is a red oval with white fangs. The green dots are three circles at the left and three at the right. Recorded with 269 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #283
works.text: A painted face in grey and gold with a tangle of colored scribble over it, two round eyes, and a mouth of white teeth in a red frame.
works.caption: A painted face in grey and gold under colored scribble, two round eyes, white teeth in a red frame.
works.reading: The face is modelled in soft grey with gold on the brow and cheek. The eyes are two rings, one with a pink center. The scribble runs over the whole square in short red, blue and yellow strokes. Recorded with 166 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #286
works.text: A skull on lavender, painted in purple, green and pink, with a beam of color crossing its eyes from the left, and a row of white teeth at the bottom. One eye socket is filled with grey and red rings; the other is dark. Thin yellow and blue lines wander over the ground. The skull is the one in the room that is almost a face, with a nose and lips drawn in, and the color is the softest.
works.caption: A skull on lavender painted in purple, green and pink, a beam of color crossing its eyes.
works.reading: The beam is a band of pink and green laid over the eyes from the left. The teeth are a row of white blocks with black lines between. The nose is a dark triangle with a small black mark. Seventy-two strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #287
works.text: A skull in grey, green and purple on a ground of soft olive circles, its eyes two dark hollows, a rainbow beam crossing from the left.
works.caption: A skull on soft olive circles, two dark hollow eyes, a rainbow beam crossing it from the left.
works.reading: The circles of the ground overlap like bubbles. The skull is painted in soft strokes with a thin black edge, and the beam crosses from the upper left to the lower right in bands of red, blue and green. Recorded with 237 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #288
works.text: A face in black and orange line on tan, its brow ruled like a grid, two round grey eyes, and a mouth of white bars.
works.caption: A face in black and orange line on tan, its brow ruled like a grid, a mouth of white bars.
works.reading: The grid on the brow is drawn in orange and black horizontal and vertical lines. The eyes are grey rings with small pupils. The mouth is a wide box of white bars with a red lip. Fifty-three strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #289
works.text: A woman with pink hair looks down on tan, her face orange, her eyes two blue rings, her mouth a row of white marks, in a blue coat.
works.caption: A woman with long pink hair looks down, her face orange, her eyes two blue rings.
works.reading: The hair falls in long pink and red strokes to the shoulders. The eyes are drawn as blue rings with dark centers, one higher than the other. The mouth is a row of small white strokes. Thirty-eight strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #290
works.text: A skull in the dark, painted in black and grey with yellow and red line, two beams coming in from the sides to meet at the eyes, a row of white teeth below. Where the lavender skull was soft and lit from one side, this one is lit from both, and the light is the only color. Black fingers reach up from the bottom edge.
works.caption: A skull in the dark lit by two beams that meet at its eyes, a row of white teeth below.
works.reading: The beams are two bands of yellow and red that come in from the left and right edges at eye height. The skull is painted in black with grey highlights and yellow line over the crown. The teeth are white blocks in a dark mouth. Recorded with 103 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #292
works.text: A hatted face with a spiral eye, a mouth of white bars and a beam from the left, in a field of colored rays, drawn in yellow and black line.
works.caption: A hatted face with a spiral eye, lit by a beam, in a field of green, blue and orange rays.
works.reading: The hat is a wide brim drawn in green and red. The rays behind the face are bands of green, blue, orange and purple. The beam from the left is yellow with zigzag inside. Recorded with 241 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #293
works.text: A cat-eared face in purple, pink and green with one huge eye and one small, a mouth of fangs, on dark navy.
works.caption: A cat-eared face in purple and green, one huge lashed eye, one small, a red mouth of fangs.
works.reading: The large eye is drawn at the upper left as a white oval with lashes and a dark pupil. The small eye at the right has a white fang below it. The mouth is a red oval with white teeth. Seventy-six strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #294
works.text: A face under a black top hat, split into a dark red side and a yellow side, with two eyes of different sizes, a grin of white teeth, and two white-gloved hands below.
works.caption: A face under a black top hat, split into dark red and yellow halves, white-gloved hands below.
works.reading: The hat is drawn in black with a yellow edge. The left eye is a blue ring with a white center, the right a small dark one. The gloves are drawn in white line with red inside. Ninety-one strokes.

chapters.title: Three in a Morning
chapters.opening: October 3, 2022. Three portraits in a single line, drawn in three hours, then two round heads in goggles to close the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #295
works.text: A face on blue drawn in one black line, with tan patches for the cheeks, two eyes with white tears, a red mouth, and yellow zigzag for the hair. A hand rises at the left. The line wanders from the brow down the nose to the chin without lifting, and the color is laid on in a few flat patches. It is the first of three portraits drawn that morning, at 06:03 UTC.
works.caption: A face on blue in one wandering black line, tan cheeks, a tear under each eye, a red mouth.
works.reading: The eyes are two small rings with a white drop under each. The hair is drawn in yellow and orange zigzag over blue. The hand at the left is drawn in tan with the fingers spread. Recorded with 101 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #296
works.text: A face on yellow drawn in black and red line, a tear on each cheek, red lips, the hair a loop of orange and black, drawn an hour and twenty minutes later.
works.caption: A face on yellow in black and red line, a tear on each cheek, red lips, orange hair.
works.reading: The tears are drawn as white and grey drops under the eyes. The face is an outline with a long nose and a small red mouth. A dark olive shape at the lower right is the shoulder. Fifty-five strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #297
works.text: A face on olive drawn in yellow, black and red line, a red mouth the only solid mark, drawn in twenty-seven strokes an hour after the second, the sparest of the three.
works.caption: A face found in a wandering line on olive, its red mouth the only solid mark.
works.reading: The line wanders over the whole square, and the face is found in it: two eyes, a nose, a mouth. A grey shadow sits behind the head. Twenty-seven strokes, the fewest in the room.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #298
works.text: A round yellow head on black with pink spots on its scalp, blue goggles, a mouth of white bars, and the words GRIFTERS GONNA GRIFT and INKERS GONNA INK written in blue beside it.
works.caption: A round yellow head in blue goggles on black, with GRIFTERS GONNA GRIFT and INKERS GONNA INK beside it.
works.reading: The goggles are two dark lenses in a blue frame with white marks inside. The scalp is pink with black dots. The lettering is blue, drawn in loose capitals at the lower left and right. A blue loop runs around the head. Recorded with 234 strokes.

works.title: nnxyz nnotb #299
works.text: A round blue head on black with yellow spikes standing up from its scalp, pink goggles, and a sunburst for a mouth, with INKERS GONNA INK at the lower left. The day after the yellow head, the same shape returns in the opposite colors, with a beam of gold falling from the mouth. It is the last portrait in the collection, drawn October 5, 2022.
works.caption: A round blue head with yellow spikes, pink goggles and a sunburst mouth, INKERS GONNA INK beside it.
works.reading: The goggles are pink lenses with yellow and dark marks inside. The mouth is a yellow sun with rays and a small face in it. The beam of gold falls from the mouth to the lower right. Recorded with 240 strokes.

closing: Look again at the old man from August, painted in a hundred small strokes with his eyes wide, and then at the face from October 3 drawn in one line with a tear on each cheek. The second has a tenth of the strokes. Both are faces that look at something, and that is what sets this room apart from the masks.
